purpose: Create a beginner-friendly training and handbook draft for the customer card using existing PWS-MD-004B and PWS-MD-004C evidence, real BC screenshots and realistic fictional business-partner context.
businessPurpose: Turn observed Universaarl customer-card UI into useful customer-facing explanation before any customer write gate, O2C process or posting claim. Use realistic fictional customers for the case study, not UI mockups or generic demo placeholders, and do not commit confidential real customer data.
acceptanceCriteria: Training text explains what a customer card is, why Fakturierung and Zahlungen matter, and which fields remain setup-dependent.
Screenshots are referenced as learning aids, not as setup-correctness proof.
Screenshots come from real Business Central playthru evidence, not mockups.
Customer examples are realistic fictional Universaarl business partners, not generic demo placeholders and not confidential real customer data.
The draft clearly states that no O2C, Preview Posting, Posting or ledger proof exists yet.
No Business Central or Playwright live execution occurs.
stopIf: The draft needs a field value that is not visible in PWS-MD-004B or PWS-MD-004C evidence.
The text would imply setup correctness, O2C readiness or posting readiness.
A live BC check would be required to answer the next question.
trainingImpact: Creates the first usable customer-card training module for Finance/Sales/Key User orientation.
uatImpact: Prepares UAT language for customer master data review without accepting customer process readiness.
bookImpact: Provides reader-facing material for the master-data/customer-card section.
